BrochureContent.Content:
Dooley Poynton Auctioneers are delighted to present for sale two exclusive, architecturally designed homes in the heart of the charming village of Redcross, Co. Wicklow.
Finished to an exceptional standard and achieving an impressive A rated BER, these outstanding homes combine contemporary comfort, energy efficiency and timeless appeal.
Ideally positioned within Redcross Village, residents will enjoy immediate access to a host of local amenities, including schools, crèches, shops and community services. The M11 motorway is just five minutes away, providing excellent connectivity to Arklow, Wicklow Town and South Dublin. Set amidst the stunning natural landscape of County Wicklow, Redcross offers an enviable balance of rural tranquility and modern convenience, a welcoming community and an ideal setting for contemporary family living.

Entrance Hallway — 6.2m x 1.9m
A welcoming entrance finished to a high standard, creating an elegant first impression.
• Premium 12mm Blond Oak laminate flooring throughout.
• Alarm system wiring provision for added security and future installation.
• Smooth plastered walls finished in premium-quality emulsion paint.
• Soaring high ceilings creating a sense of openness and grandeur.
Living Room — 4.2m x 3.4m
A bright and inviting reception room, combining contemporary comfort with distinctive period character.
• Premium 12mm Blond Oak laminate flooring.
• Feature-ready wall, suitable for a bespoke media unit
• Generous triple-glazed sash window overlooking the front, maximising natural light while adding timeless heritage appeal.
Kitchen / Dining Room — 5.0m x 5.4m
A beautifully considered bespoke Eugene Dunne crafted kitchen and dining space designed with both style and everyday functionality in mind.
• Premium 12mm Blond Oak laminate flooring.
• Bespoke kitchen designed and built by Eugene Dunne, featuring:
o Soft-close cabinetry.
o Electric induction hob.
o Curved glass extraction hood.
o High-quality sink.
o Integrated LED under-cabinet lighting.
• Premium solid granite quartz stone worktop and upstand with a sleek, contemporary finish.
• Layout thoughtfully optimised by Eleanor Sheahan - Architect to maximise natural light, movement, flow and usability.



Guest WC — 1.9m x 1.5m
A stylish and practical guest WC finished with contemporary detailing.
• High-durability floor tiling.
• Coordinating backsplash fitted above the sink.
• Contemporary sanitaryware selected for its clean lines and modern aesthetic.
Utility Room — 1.9m x 1.8m
A practical and well-appointed utility space designed to maximise convenience and storage.
• Fully plumbed for washing machine installation.
• Clean, streamlined wall finish without backsplash.
• Dedicated space for shelving or tall storage units, providing excellent potential for additional household storage.
Bedroom 1 — 3.2m x 3.2m
A spacious principal bedroom suite designed with comfort, style and quality craftsmanship in mind.
• Walk in wardrobes by Eugene Dunne with shelving hanging drawers.
• Generously proportioned walk-in wardrobe providing excellent storage.
• Private en-suite bathroom finished to a contemporary standard.
Walk-In Wardrobe — 1.8m x 1.8m En-Suite — 1.8m x 2.65m
En-Suite Bathroom
A beautifully finished en-suite combining practical features with modern detailing.
• Fully tiled floor.
• Floor-to-ceiling tiling within the shower enclosure.
• Contemporary shower panel.
• Coordinating backsplash above the vanity area.
• Illuminated designer mirror.
Bedroom 2 — 4.2m x 2.65m
A bright and well-proportioned bedroom with excellent built-in storage.
• Bespoke fitted wardrobes.
• Eugene Dunne wardrobe doors and internal finishes.
Bedroom 3 — 2.7m x 2.65m
A versatile third bedroom offering a comfortable space suitable for a child’s bedroom, guest room or home office.
Family Bathroom — 2.3m x 2.1m
A stylish and practical family bathroom finished with quality contemporary fittings.
• Fully tiled floor.
• Floor-to-ceiling tiling within the shower enclosure.
• Coordinating backsplash above the sink.
• Premium shower door.
• Free standing statement bath with luxurious full height featured tiled wall.
First-Floor Storage
A dedicated first-floor storage room provides valuable additional space and exceptional everyday practicality.
• Ideal for linen, household essentials and seasonal storage.
• Conveniently positioned for easy access.
Second Floor — Uninhabitable Attic Space 5m x 4.4m
An exceptionally useful attic storage area offering generous additional capacity and long-term flexibility.
• Accessed via fitted stairs.
• Fully floored and walled for storage purposes.
• Velux windows provide natural light and ventilation.
• Excellent potential for future storage requirements and adaptable use, subject to the necessary planning and building regulations.
Garden & External Space
The private garden has been carefully finished to create an attractive and functional outdoor setting, ideal for relaxing, entertaining and family life.
• Concrete footpath extending across the full width of the property.
• Dedicated limestone patio area suitable for outdoor dining and seating.
• Garden professionally levelled, flattened and seeded.
• Secure rear access gate.
• Boundary treatments thoughtfully designed to complement the surrounding village character.

Craftsmanship & Heritage
This home brings together traditional architectural character with modern construction standards and carefully selected finishes.
KHCL Construction — Quality & Craftsmanship
KHCL Construction’s approach is reflected throughout the property, with an emphasis on precision, durability and performance.
• Precision-crafted timber work.
• High-grade insulation.
• Durable, long-life roofing materials.
• Excellent airtightness and energy performance.
• Quality construction designed for lasting comfort and efficiency.
Architectural Vision — Eleanor Sheahan - Architect
The architectural design thoughtfully balances the character of a traditional village setting with the requirements of contemporary family living.
• Traditional Main Street proportions.
• Heritage-appropriate sash windows.
• Modern internal layouts carefully optimised for family life.
• Sustainable, energy-efficient A-rated building envelope.
Bespoke Kitchen & Wardrobe Craftsmanship — Eugene Dunne
The kitchen has been individually designed and crafted by Eugene Dunne, combining bespoke workmanship with everyday functionality.
• Bespoke cabinetry.
• Durable, high-quality materials.
• Intelligent, functional layout.
• Clean, contemporary finishes.
• Thoughtful detailing designed to create a kitchen that is both beautiful and practical.
A distinctive home where heritage character, contemporary design and exceptional craftsmanship come together to create a truly considered living environment.

• Brand-New Three-Bedroom Semi-Detached Home arranged over three spacious floors.
• A-Rated BER, offering excellent energy efficiency, comfort and long-term running cost benefits.
• Conveniently located just 5 minutes’ drive from the M11, providing excellent connectivity.
• Approximately 4 miles from Brittas Bay, renowned for its beautiful European Blue Flag beach.
• Excellent local school transport links, with a school bus passing directly by the property serving schools in Arklow and Wicklow Town.
• Additional school transport to Wicklow Town’s national and secondary schools including CCM and East Glendalough from Redcross Village.
• Conveniently located within easy reach of Redcross National School, Barndarrig National School and Brittas Bay National School.
• Triple-glazed PVC sash windows to the front elevation, combining traditional heritage styling with modern thermal and acoustic performance.
• Double-glazed PVC windows to the rear.
• All windows and external doors supplied by Munster Joinery, reflecting a commitment to quality, performance and durability.
For directions to the property, please use Eircode A67F6P9  (next door to new houses)
